'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli military operation in the northern West Bank]]
***Three [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] militants, including Hamas' leader in [[Jenin]], Wissam Hazem, are killed in a [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] at the [[Jenin refugee camp]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/30/israel-presses-on-with-assault-on-occupied-west-bank-for-third-day (Al Jazeera)]
**An [[Israel]]i soldier is killed and several others are injured in an [[Improvised explosive device|IED]] attack in Jenin, West Bank. [https://www.palestinechronicle.com/israeli-soldier-killed-in-jenin-ambush-army-claims-hamas-leader-eliminated-in-strike/ (''Palestine Chronicle'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***Seven people are killed when a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[guided bomb]] strikes a residential building and playground in [[Kharkiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-attack-ukraines-kharkiv-kills-four-injures-28-2024-08-30/ (Reuters)]
**[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] dismisses the commander of the [[Ukrainian Air Force]] [[Mykola Oleshchuk]] following the crash of an [[F-16 fighter jet]] and the death of its pilot while defending against [[Russia]]n strikes. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/zelenskiy-dismisses-ukraines-air-force-commander-2024-08-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***Seven people are killed and 25 others are injured in [[Shell (projectile)|shelling]] near [[Khartoum]], [[Sudan]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article290194/ (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Twelve [[Pakistani Taliban]] members are killed during a raid by the [[Pakistan Army|Pakistani Army]] in the [[Tirah|Tirah Valley]] of [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], bringing the number of insurgents killed there to 37 since August 20. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-security-forces-militant-hideouts-killed-c3e7c6e79738e5105ee630b852b90786 (AP)]
*[[Islamic State insurgency in Iraq (2017–present)|Islamic State insurgency in Iraq]]
**At least 15 [[Islamic State]] militants are killed and seven [[US Armed Forces|U.S. troops]] are injured in a joint [[United States]]–[[Iraqi Armed Forces|Iraq]] raid on Islamic State camps in [[Al Anbar Governorate|Anbar Desert]], [[Iraq]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iraq-us-islamic-state-group-raid-4215a262b3e0bf7a2afb896c84ed6b55 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Venezuelan blackouts]]
**A widespread [[power outage]] affects most of [[Venezuela]] with President Nicolás Maduro's [[Government of Venezuela|government]] blaming it on [[sabotage]] by the [[venezuelan opposition|opposition]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/venezuela-claims-sabotage-in-widespread-power-outage/a-70094747 (DW)] 
*Four people are killed and one other is missing when a [[National Republican Guard (Portugal)|National Republican Guard]] helicopter crashes into the [[Douro]] river in [[Lamego, Portugal|Lamego]], [[Portugal]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/portugal-4-dead-1-missing-after-firefighter-helicopter-crash/a-70097141 (DW)] 
*At least two people are killed and 20 others are injured when a roof of a church that was used for [[food distribution]] collapses in [[Recife]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/least-2-dead-after-brazil-church-roof-collapses-mayor-says-2024-08-30/ (Reuters)] [https://www.yahoo.com/news/church-roof-collapses-brazil-city-082043177.html (Yahoo! News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Afghanistan–Germany relations]]
**[[Government of Germany|Germany]] [[deport]]s 28 [[convicted]] [[Afghans|Afghan]] criminals, marking the first such action since the [[Taliban]] regained control of [[Afghanistan]] in [[2021 Taliban offensive|August 2021]]. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-afghanistan-deportations-solingen-710560de4b2855dfaae6275d090111cd (AP)]
*[[Mongolia–Russia relations]], [[Foreign relations of Ukraine]]
**[[President of Ukraine]] [[Volodomyr Zelenskyy]] urges [[Mongolia]] to arrest [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] as he travels to [[Ulaanbaatar]] to make his first meeting to an [[International Criminal Court]] member state since the issue of his ICC arrest warrant. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20240830-ukraine-urges-mongolia-to-arrest-putin-on-icc-warrant-kremlin-says-it-has-no-worries-about-visit (France 24)]
*[[Russia–NATO relations]], [[Ukraine–NATO relations]], [[2024 Kursk offensive]]
**[[Secretary General of NATO]] [[Jens Stoltenberg]] declares that [[Ukraine]]'s incursion into [[Russia]]n territory in [[Kursk Oblast]] is legitimate under [[international law]], as part of Ukraine's [[Self-defence in international law|right to self-defense]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraines-incursion-into-russias-kursk-region-is-legitimate-says-natos-2024-08-31/ (Reuters)]
*[[East Timor]] joins the [[World Trade Organization]]. [https://www.wto.org/english/news_e/news24_e/acc_30aug24_e.htm (WTO)]

**Incumbent [[Māori King movement|Māori King]] [[Tūheitia Paki|Tūheitia]] [[Death of Tūheitia Paki|dies]] at the age of 69 while recovering from [[heart surgery]]. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/waikato-news/news/maori-king-tuheitia-dies-aged-69/ZM56KO62GVBLDMSXJYH66R2PRQ/ (''New Zealand Herald'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 ATP Tour]]
**[[2024 US Open – Men's singles]]
***Defending men's champion [[Novak Djokovic]] is defeated in the third round by [[Alexei Popyrin]], 6-4, 6-4, 2-6, 6-4, making 2024 the first tennis season since [[2002 ATP Tour|2002]] in which no [[Grand Slam (tennis)|Grand Slam]] tournaments were won by one of Djokovic, [[Roger Federer]], or [[Rafael Nadal]], collectively known as the "[[Big Three (tennis)|big three]]."
